findings.issue: The REQUEST A QUOTE button still ends right on the top edge of the tinted trustBar band with no white space under it, because the plain hero's inner still has no bottom padding.
findings.reference: The competitor's plain hero (hero:plain) leaves clear white space under its centred title and lead before the next module starts.
findings.fix: In template.css, give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding (e.g. padding-block-end: calc(var(--section-space) / 2)) so a tinted neighbour never starts right under the hero's button.

findings.issue: At desktop the hero button still ends only a few pixels above the tinted trustBar band, so it looks pushed into the band.
findings.reference: The competitor leaves an open white gap under its centred title and lead before the next module.
findings.fix: The same template change: give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding.

findings.issue: On phones the centred hero lead ends in a short last line ('is made.'), which looks like a stray fragment under four full centred lines.
findings.reference: The competitor's centred phone lead ends in a line close to the length of the lines above it.
findings.fix: In reference.css, set text-wrap: balance (or pretty) on .page-hero__lead so the centred lines even out.

findings.issue: Stacked one per row on phones, the four contact cards each carry a full-width black label bar set as large as on desktop, so four heavy black bars dominate the screen.
findings.reference: The competitor's channel cards on phones keep a compact black pill label with small type in each card.
findings.fix: In reference.css under max-width: 767px, size the label of .contact-channels[data-variant="cards"] .contact-channel down (smaller font-size and padding-block), keeping the card's one-column stack.

findings.issue: The consent line still ends '…as described in the privacy policy. Privacy policy', repeating the link's words right after the sentence (the same on mobile).
findings.reference: The competitor's form has no repeated text.
findings.fix: End the consent copy before the link (e.g. '…as described in our') or make 'privacy policy' inside the sentence the link.

findings.issue: The headings 'Contact details' and 'Send an enquiry' are still in sentence case, while the page's other section headings ('Frequently Asked Questions', 'What to Expect Once You Get in Touch') are in title case.
findings.reference: The competitor sets all its contact-page headings in title case ('Contact Us', 'Have Questions?', 'Email Us').
findings.fix: Write the two headings in title case ('Contact Details', 'Send an Enquiry') in the page copy.
